ITEM.PTXT: Moving the shift lever to the S position enables shift range switching with the sequential Shiftmatic. In addition, at the same time as shifting to the S position, the 5 range or 4 range is entered according to vehicle speed. (During AI-SHIFT control, the highest range being controlled is displayed.)
By operating either the shift lever +/- or the paddle switch +/-, a shift signal is sent to the transmission control computer, and the range is switched between the 6 to 1 ranges.
